ESV.1: Draw near, O nations, to hear, and give attention, O peoples! Let the earth hear, and all that fills it; the world, and all that comes from it.
ESV.2: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations, and furious against all their host; he has devoted them to destruction,  has given them over for slaughter.
ESV.3: Their slain shall be cast out, and the stench of their corpses shall rise; the mountains shall flow with their blood.
ESV.4: All the host of heaven shall rot away, and the skies roll up like a scroll. All their host shall fall, as leaves fall from the vine, like leaves falling from the fig tree.
ESV.5: For my sword has drunk its fill in the heavens; behold, it descends for judgment upon Edom, upon the people I have devoted to destruction.
ESV.6: The LORD has a sword; it is sated with blood; it is gorged with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
ESV.7: Wild oxen shall fall with them, and young steers with the mighty bulls. Their land shall drink its fill of blood, and their soil shall be gorged with fat.
ESV.8: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
ESV.9: And the streams of Edom  shall be turned into pitch, and her soil into sulfur; her land shall become burning pitch.
ESV.10: Night and day it shall not be quenched; its smoke shall go up forever. From generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it forever and ever.
ESV.11: But the hawk and the porcupine  shall possess it, the owl and the raven shall dwell in it. He shall stretch the line of confusion  over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.
ESV.12: Its nobles — there is no one there to call it a kingdom, and all its princes shall be nothing.
ESV.13: Thorns shall grow over its strongholds, nettles and thistles in its fortresses. It shall be the haunt of jackals, an abode for ostriches.
ESV.14: And wild animals shall meet with hyenas; the wild goat shall cry to his fellow; indeed, there the night bird  settles and finds for herself a resting place.
ESV.15: There the owl nests and lays and hatches and gathers her young in her shadow; indeed, there the hawks are gathered, each one with her mate.
ESV.16: Seek and read from the book of the LORD: Not one of these shall be missing; none shall be without her mate. For the mouth of the LORD has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.
ESV.17: He has cast the lot for them; his hand has portioned it out to them with the line; they shall possess it forever; from generation to generation they shall dwell in it.

NASB.1: Draw near, O nations, to hear; and listen, O peoples! Let the earth and all it contains hear, and the world and all that springs from it.
NASB.2: For the LORD'S indignation is against all the nations, And [His] wrath against all their armies; He has utterly destroyed them, He has given them over to slaughter.
NASB.3: So their slain will be thrown out, And their corpses will give off their stench, And the mountains will be drenched with their blood.
NASB.4: And all the host of heaven will wear away, And the sky will be rolled up like a scroll; All their hosts will also wither away As a leaf withers from the vine, Or as [one] withers from the fig tree.
NASB.5: For My sword is satiated in heaven, Behold it shall descend for judgment upon Edom And upon the people whom I have devoted to destruction.
NASB.6: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, It is sated with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, With the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
NASB.7: Wild oxen will also fall with them And young bulls with strong ones; Thus their land will be soaked with blood, And their dust become greasy with fat.
NASB.8: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, A year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
NASB.9: Its streams will be turned into pitch, And its loose earth into brimstone, And its land will become burning pitch.
NASB.10: It will not be quenched night or day; Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation it will be desolate; None will pass through it forever and ever.
NASB.11: But pelican and hedgehog will possess it, And owl and raven will dwell in it; And He will stretch over it the line of desolation And the plumb line of emptiness.
NASB.12: Its nobles-- there is no one there [Whom] they may proclaim king-- And all its princes will be nothing.
NASB.13: Thorns will come up in its fortified towers, Nettles and thistles in its fortified cities; It will also be a haunt of jackals [And] an abode of ostriches.
NASB.14: The desert creatures will meet with the wolves, The hairy goat also will cry to its kind; Yes, the night monster will settle there And will find herself a resting place.
NASB.15: The tree snake will make its nest and lay [eggs] there, And it will hatch and gather [them] under its protection. Yes, the hawks will be gathered there, Every one with its kind.
NASB.16: Seek from the book of the LORD, and read: Not one of these will be missing; None will lack its mate. For His mouth has commanded, And His Spirit has gathered them.
NASB.17: He has cast the lot for them, And His hand has divided it to them by line. They shall possess it forever; From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

NKJV.1: Come near, you nations, to hear; And heed, you people!  Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, The world and all things that come forth from it.
NKJV.2: For the indignation of the LORD is against all nations, And His fury against all their armies; He has utterly destroyed them, He has given them over to the slaughter.
NKJV.3: Also their slain shall be thrown out;  Their stench shall rise from their corpses, And the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
NKJV.4: All the host of heaven shall be dissolved, And the heavens shall be rolled up like a scroll; All their host shall fall down As the leaf falls from the vine, And as fruit falling from a fig tree.
NKJV.5: “For My sword shall be bathed in heaven; Indeed it shall come down on Edom, And on the people of My curse, for judgment.
NKJV.6: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, It is made overflowing with fatness, With the blood of lambs and goats, With the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
NKJV.7: The wild oxen shall come down with them, And the young bulls with the mighty bulls; Their land shall be soaked with blood, And their dust saturated with fatness.”
NKJV.8: For it is the day of the LORD’s vengeance, The year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
NKJV.9: Its streams shall be turned into pitch, And its dust into brimstone; Its land shall become burning pitch.
NKJV.10: It shall not be quenched night or day;  Its smoke shall ascend forever.  From generation to generation it shall lie waste; No one shall pass through it forever and ever.
NKJV.11: But the pelican and the porcupine shall possess it, Also the owl and the raven shall dwell in it. And He shall stretch out over it The line of confusion and the stones of emptiness.
NKJV.12: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, But none shall be there, and all its princes shall be nothing.
NKJV.13: And thorns shall come up in its palaces, Nettles and brambles in its fortresses;  It shall be a habitation of jackals, A courtyard for ostriches.
NKJV.14: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the jackals, And the wild goat shall bleat to its companion; Also the night creature shall rest there, And find for herself a place of rest.
NKJV.15: There the arrow snake shall make her nest and lay eggs And hatch, and gather them under her shadow; There also shall the hawks be gathered, Every one with her mate.
NKJV.16: “Search from the book of the LORD, and read: Not one of these shall fail; Not one shall lack her mate. For My mouth has commanded it, and His Spirit has gathered them.
NKJV.17: He has cast the lot for them, And His hand has divided it among them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever; From generation to generation they shall dwell in it.”

NLT.1:
Come here and listen, O nations of the earth.
Let the world and everything in it hear my words.
NLT.2:
For the LORD is enraged against the nations.
His fury is against all their armies.
He will completely destroy them,
dooming them to slaughter.
NLT.3:
Their dead will be left unburied,
and the stench of rotting bodies will fill the land.
The mountains will flow with their blood.
NLT.4:
The heavens above will melt away
and disappear like a rolled-up scroll.
The stars will fall from the sky
like withered leaves from a grapevine,
or shriveled figs from a fig tree.
NLT.5:
And when my sword has finished its work in the heavens,
it will fall upon Edom,
the nation I have marked for destruction.
NLT.6:
The sword of the LORD is drenched with blood
and covered with fat —
with the blood of lambs and goats,
with the fat of rams prepared for sacrifice.
Yes, the LORD will offer a sacrifice in the city of Bozrah.
He will make a mighty slaughter in Edom.
NLT.7:
Even men as strong as wild oxen will die —
the young men alongside the veterans.
The land will be soaked with blood
and the soil enriched with fat.
NLT.8:
For it is the day of the LORD’s revenge,
the year when Edom will be paid back for all it did to Israel.
NLT.9:
The streams of Edom will be filled with burning pitch,
and the ground will be covered with fire.
NLT.10:
This judgment on Edom will never end;
the smoke of its burning will rise forever.
The land will lie deserted from generation to generation.
No one will live there anymore.
NLT.11:
It will be haunted by the desert owl and the screech owl,
the great owl and the raven.
For God will measure that land carefully;
he will measure it for chaos and destruction.
NLT.12:
It will be called the Land of Nothing,
and all its nobles will soon be gone.
NLT.13:
Thorns will overrun its palaces;
nettles and thistles will grow in its forts.
The ruins will become a haunt for jackals
and a home for owls.
NLT.14:
Desert animals will mingle there with hyenas,
their howls filling the night.
Wild goats will bleat at one another among the ruins,
and night creatures will come there to rest.
NLT.15:
There the owl will make her nest and lay her eggs.
She will hatch her young and cover them with her wings.
And the buzzards will come,
each one with its mate.
NLT.16:
Search the book of the LORD,
and see what he will do.
Not one of these birds and animals will be missing,
and none will lack a mate,
for the LORD has promised this.
His Spirit will make it all come true.
NLT.17:
He has surveyed and divided the land
and deeded it over to those creatures.
They will possess it forever,
from generation to generation.

WEB.1: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear; the world, and everything that comes from it.
WEB.2: For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.
WEB.3: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up; and the mountains will melt in their blood.
WEB.4: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.
WEB.5: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.
WEB.6: Yahweh’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
WEB.7: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.
WEB.8: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
WEB.9: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, And its land will become burning pitch.
WEB.10: It won’t be quenched night nor day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.
WEB.11: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.
WEB.12: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.
WEB.13: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.
WEB.14: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature  shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.
WEB.15: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.
WEB.16: Search in the book of Yahweh, and read: not one of these will be missing. none will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.
WEB.17: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

AMP.1:
Come near, you nations, to hear; and listen, O peoples!
Let the earth and all that is in it hear, and the world and all that comes forth from it.
AMP.2:
For the LORD is angry at all the nations,
And His wrath is against all their armies;
He has utterly doomed them,
He has given them over to slaughter.
AMP.3:
So their slain will be thrown out,
And the stench of their corpses will rise,
And the mountains will flow with their blood.
AMP.4:
All the host of heaven will be dissolved,
And the skies will be rolled up like a scroll;
All their hosts [the stars and the planets] will also wither away
As a leaf withers from the vine,
And as a fig withers from the fig tree.
AMP.5:
For My sword is satiated [with blood] in heaven;
Indeed, it will come down for judgment on Edom
And on the people whom I have doomed for destruction.
AMP.6:
The sword of the LORD is filled with blood [from sacrifices],
It drips with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats,
With the fat of the kidneys of rams.
For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah (Edom's capital city)
And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
AMP.7:
Wild oxen will also fall with them
And the young bulls with the strong bulls;
And their land will be soaked with blood,
And their dust made greasy with fat.
AMP.8:
For the LORD has a day of vengeance,
A year of retribution for the cause of Zion.
AMP.9:
The streams [of Edom] will be turned into pitch,
And its dust into brimstone,
And its land will become burning pitch.
AMP.10:
The burning will not be quenched night or day;
Its smoke will go up forever.
From generation to generation it will lie in ruins;
No one will ever again pass through it.
AMP.11:
But the pelican and the porcupine will take possession of it;
The owl and the raven will dwell in it.
And He will stretch over it (Edom) the measuring line of desolation
And the plumb line of emptiness.
AMP.12:
Its nobles—there is no one there
Whom they may proclaim king—
And all its princes will be nothing.
AMP.13:
Thorns will come up in its fortified palaces,
Nettles and brambles in its fortified cities;
It will be a haunt for jackals,
An abode for ostriches.
AMP.14:
The creatures of the desert will encounter jackals
And the hairy goat will call to its kind;
Indeed, Lilith (night demon) will settle there
And find herself a place of rest.
AMP.15:
There the arrow snake will make her nest and lay her eggs,
And hatch them and gather her young under her protection;
Indeed, the birds of prey will be gathered there [to breed],
Every one with its own kind.
AMP.16:
Seek from the book of the LORD, and read:
Not one of these [creatures] will be missing;
None will lack its mate.
For His mouth has commanded,
And His Spirit has gathered them.
AMP.17:
The LORD has cast the lot for them,
And His hand has divided and apportioned Edom to the wild beasts by measuring-line.
They will possess it forever;
From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

MSG.1:

you people. Pay attention!
Earth, you too, and everything in you.
World, and all that comes from you.
MSG.2:

good and angry with all the nations,
So blazingly angry at their arms and armies
that he's going to rid earth of them, wipe them out.
MSG.3:
The corpses, thrown in a heap,
will stink like the town dump in midsummer,
Their blood flowing off the mountains
like creeks in spring runoff.
MSG.4:
Stars will fall out of the sky
like overripe, rotting fruit in the orchard,
And the sky itself will be folded up like a blanket
and put away in a closet.
All that army of stars, shriveled to nothing,
like leaves and fruit in autumn, dropping and rotting!
MSG.5:
"Once I've finished with earth and sky,
I'll start in on Edom.
I'll come down hard on Edom,
a people I've slated for total termination."
MSG.6:
God has a sword, thirsty for blood and more blood,
a sword hungry for well-fed flesh,
Lamb and goat blood,
the suet-rich kidneys of rams.
Yes, God has scheduled a sacrifice in Bozrah, the capital,
the whole country of Edom a slaughterhouse.
MSG.7:
A wholesale slaughter, wild animals
and farm animals alike slaughtered.
The whole country soaked with blood,
all the ground greasy with fat.
MSG.8:
It's God's scheduled time for vengeance,
the year all Zion's accounts are settled.
MSG.9:
Edom's streams will flow sluggish, thick with pollution,
the soil sterile, poisoned with waste,
The whole country
a smoking, stinking garbage dump—
MSG.10:
The fires burning day and night,
the skies black with endless smoke.
Generation after generation of wasteland—
no more travelers through this country!
MSG.11:
Vultures and skunks will police the streets;

God will reverse creation. Chaos!

MSG.12:

A country where all kings
and princes are unemployed.
MSG.13:

MSG.15:

NET.1: Come near, you nations, and listen! Pay attention, you people! The earth and everything it contains must listen, the world and everything that lives in it.
NET.2: For the LORD is angry at all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will annihilate them and slaughter them.
NET.3: Their slain will be left unburied, their corpses will stink; the hills will soak up their blood.
NET.4: All the stars in the sky will fade away, the sky will roll up like a scroll; all its stars will wither, like a leaf withers and falls from a vine or a fig withers and falls from a tree.
NET.5: He says, “Indeed, my sword has slaughtered heavenly powers. Look, it now descends on Edom, on the people I will annihilate in judgment.”
NET.6: The LORD’s sword is dripping with blood, it is covered with fat; it drips with the blood of young rams and goats and is covered with the fat of rams’ kidneys. For the LORD is holding a sacrifice in Bozrah, a bloody slaughter in the land of Edom.
NET.7: Wild oxen will be slaughtered along with them, as well as strong bulls. Their land is drenched with blood, their soil is covered with fat.
NET.8: For the LORD has planned a day of revenge, a time when he will repay Edom for her hostility toward Zion.
NET.9: Edom’s streams will be turned into pitch and her soil into brimstone; her land will become burning pitch.
NET.10: Night and day it will burn; its smoke will ascend continually. Generation after generation it will be a wasteland and no one will ever pass through it again.
NET.11: Owls and wild animals will live there, all kinds of wild birds will settle in it. The LORD will stretch out over her the measuring line of ruin and the plumb line of destruction.
NET.12: Her nobles will have nothing left to call a kingdom and all her officials will disappear.
NET.13: Her fortresses will be overgrown with thorns; thickets and weeds will grow in her fortified cities. Jackals will settle there; ostriches will live there.
NET.14: Wild animals and wild dogs will congregate there; wild goats will bleat to one another. Yes, nocturnal animals will rest there and make for themselves a nest.
NET.15: Owls will make nests and lay eggs there; they will hatch them and protect them. Yes, hawks will gather there, each with its mate.
NET.16: Carefully read the scroll of the LORD! Not one of these creatures will be missing, none will lack a mate. For the LORD has issued the decree, and his own spirit gathers them.
NET.17: He assigns them their allotment; he measures out their assigned place. They will live there permanently; they will settle in it through successive generations.
